stem.text: A proton enters the uniform electric field between two parallel vertical metal plates in a vacuum.
One plate is at a potential of $0\,\text{V}$ and the other plate is at a potential of $+10\,\text{V}$, as shown.

stem.alt: Two parallel vertical metal plates, labelled 0 V and +10 V, with a proton path drawn as an arrow entering through a hole in the left plate, labelled path of proton and metal plates.

stem.text: What is the initial change in the motion of the proton caused by the electric field, immediately after the proton enters the field?
